name: Nifty
summary: Project management with projects, tasks, docs and discussions in one workspace, a free plan for 2 active projects and unlimited members, and paid plans per member or one flat price for the team.
best_for: Small teams and agencies that want projects, tasks, docs and discussions in one place and can live with 2 active projects on the free plan
skip_if: you need milestones as their own item on a timeline, more than 2 active projects for free, or you want a track record you can check before you move your team
honest_knock: The free limit is easy to miss. New accounts start on a 14 day Business trial, so in our test a third project opened with no warning; under Free only 2 projects stay active and the rest turn read only. The Roadmap has no milestone type, only lists with dates, and Discussions is hidden until you switch it on.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month, Pro per member, billed yearly, before tax, as the in-app plan screen showed on 21 November 2026
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-21 in the Nifty app and on niftypm.com/pricing) Free is $0 forever with unlimited members, 2 active projects, 500 tasks and 100 MB of files. Per member and billed yearly, Pro is $10 and Business $16 a month. Billed monthly they are $16 and $25. As one flat price for the team, billed yearly, Pro is $79 (up to 10 members) and Business $124 (up to 30 members), and Unlimited is $399; billed monthly they are $99, $149 and $499. Enterprise is on request. White labeling is an add-on at $40 a month. Prices exclude tax.

sessions.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 21 November 2026, with the interface set to English. We made a project with two dated lists on the Roadmap, five tasks, a doc and a post in Discussions. About 3 minutes passed between the start and the finished project with its tasks, and about 25 clicks. A new account starts on a 14 day Business trial without a card, so we stayed on that trial and paid nothing. We did not delete the account.
findings: Start: onboarding offered Start fresh, Bring your work and Build with Nifty AI. Start fresh asked only for a project name and a colour. Right after that the app showed "14 days left on trial", ending on 5 December 2026.

Milestones: the Roadmap tab has no milestone type. The only match we found was a list with "Show in roadmap" ticked, which draws a dated bar such as "0 of 3 tasks". We used two lists, Design and Launch, and they showed on the Roadmap as bars.

Tasks: Nifty set an end date on every new task by itself (23 November). We set one deadline ourselves and assigned one task to ourselves. The add task row under a list overlapped at times, and the plus button in the list header worked every time.

Discussions: the Discussions tab was hidden by default. We switched it on under Add view, then Project views, and posted a message. The chat panel showed only ourselves, since nobody else was invited.

Free limit: the trial hid it. We opened a third project and Nifty gave no warning. The plan screen read "Projects 3 Included in your plan". Under Free the page says "Up to 2 active projects, 500 tasks and 100 MB of files", and the Free limits link adds that you pick the 2 projects that stay active and the rest turn read only.

Plans: the upgrade screen listed Free at $0 forever with unlimited members. The per-member yearly rates on that screen were $10 (Pro) and $16 (Business) a month. Monthly it was $16 and $25. A flat price for the whole team was $79 (Pro) and $124 (Business) billed yearly, and $99 and $149 monthly. We opened the payment screen for Pro ("Due today $99.00") and closed it without entering anything.
not_tested: Not tested: moving down to Free and what it does to a third project, the 100 MB file limit (the app showed 1 TB during the trial), inviting colleagues, integrations, AI features, client portals and agents.
Not tested: paying. We opened the payment screen and closed it, so we cannot say how billing or cancelling a paid plan works.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
